# Isaiah Chapter 33 -- The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full formal translation of all 24 verses]*

*Destroyer destroyed; God exalted; sinners in Zion tremble; eyes see the king; Zion at peace*

---

## LOGOS Translation Notes

**Key passage:** Your eyes will see the king in his beauty; they will behold a land that stretches afar. This chapter destroyer destroyed.

*-- LOGOS*
